description: Pub. 544 (2025), next example: 'you receive only real property with an FMV of $200,000 in the exchange and no cash. The gain realized on the exchange is $80,000 ... and the gain recognized is $0 ... Section 1250(a)(1)(A) recapture $10,000 Less: FMV section 1250 property received 200,000 Section 1250(d)(4)(A) limit $0 Because the section 1250(d)(4)(A) recapture is limited to $0, the $10,000 of ordinary income recapture attaches to the property acquired'.
